messages:
maria (Partnerships): Heads-up — vendor called this morning: H100 racks in eu-west are showing thermal throttling under sustained 40k-token workloads. They're pushing for an embargoed announce window if we can't guarantee slot stability. We need a short, actionable failover + surge playbook for Marketplace slots. Can ops/runtime/sre triage now? :warning:

alex (Ops): On it. Quick questions: which SKU mix is most at-risk (H100 vs H200 vs Gaudi vs MI300)? I can draft capacity fallback policies and a surge handoff doc.

sam (Runtime): From our telemetry H100 long-context tails + batch sizes >8 are the hit. H200 less so, Gaudi behaves differently thermal-wise. Short-term idea: enforce burst cap for H100 on marketplace routes and route excess to H200/MI300-compatible variants.

jin (Partner Eng): I've got the vendor TPM on standby for 4pm call. I'll ask for confirmed thermal thresholds and whether firmware patch ETA exists. Also need to align press/embargo windows if swaps will impact availability.

elena (SRE): Monitoring owner here — we should add two quick alerts: 1) GPU die temp > 85C sustained for 5m on any rack; 2) queue latency spike > 200ms + token drop rate. I can push alerts and a dashboard tile in 15m.

alex (Ops): Drafting fallback policy now. Proposal (brief):
- Marketplace route /models/redwood/h100: soft-cap 75% of advertised slots during surge window
- Overflow routing policy: route to /models/redwood/h200 or /models/redwood/mi300-compatible with price-adjust delta
- Auto-rollover: if a slot degrades under thermal alert, reassign active requests to fallback with sticky session window = 60s

sam (Runtime): Implementation notes for router config:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: "/models/redwood/h100"
    soft_cap: 0.75
    fallbacks: ["/models/redwood/h200","/models/redwood/mi300-q4"]
    sticky_session_secs: 60
```
I'll open a PR to runtime router in 10m.

maria (Partnerships): Great — Jin, please flag to vendor we might need an explicit short-term embargo exception for customers in eu-west who prebooked H100 slots. We want to avoid surprise press if capacity is moved.

jin (Partner Eng): Yup. I'll request a short exception window and confirm whether firmware hotfix can be backported. Also asking their oncall for thermal patch logs.

elena (SRE): Push checklist for playbook ops runbook:
1) Enable the two alerts (I)
2) Apply soft-cap routing (alex/sam)
3) Notify marketplace customers via banner + support triage doc (maria + support)
4) If hotfix arrives, coordinate canary on 5 racks in eu-west before full rollout

alex (Ops): I'll handle marketplace banner text and the automated customer email template. Draft ETA 45m.

sam (Runtime): PR created: runtime/route-fallbacks (#487). Includes the YAML above + unit tests for sticky sessions. Requesting review from @elena and @alex.

elena (SRE): Reviewing in 5. Also adding a circuit-breaker rule to reduce sustained batching for H100 to batch_size <= 8 during the surge window.

maria (Partnerships): Owners & quick ETAs: Jin — vendor ask (by 16:00). Alex — banner + comms (45m). Sam — router PR (done). Elena — alerts + canary plan (15m for alerts). I'll prepare a short customer-facing FAQ and SLAs note. If everyone agrees, I'll summarize and post to #support and #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: oncall_rotation: elena is oncall for SRE tonight (auto note).

alex (Ops): Agree — go ahead. One more ask: add a fallback cost delta line item so finance/marketplace can show cost differences to customers if their requests shift to MI300/H200. I'll coordinate with billing.

maria (Partnerships): Good catch. I'll add a single-line note in the FAQ. OK let's reconvene after the 4pm vendor call. If anything critical pops, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
